narrative.introduction: This domain covers culinary nuts, edible seeds, and nut- and seed-derived ingredients used worldwide in cooking — organized around how they're used in the kitchen, not botanical taxonomy, snack products, confectionery, or prepared foods.
narrative.seo_description: Culinary nuts and seeds across six groups: Tree Nuts, Peanuts, Edible Seeds, Seed Spices, Nut Products, and Seed Products.
